items.title: Oracle Allegedly Breached by Clop Ransomware via E-Business Suite 0-Day Hack
items.description: The notorious Clop ransomware gang has listed Oracle on its dark web leak site, alleging a successful breach of the tech giant’s internal systems. This development is part of a massive extortion campaign exploiting a critical zero-day vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), designated as CVE-2025-61882.
